title: Anthony Levandowski on lessons learned at TC Sessions: Robotics+AI
summary: A TechCrunch interview with Anthony Levandowski about his new startup Pronto.ai and autonomous vehicles, after the Uber and Waymo lawsuit. He discusses lessons learned and the role of lidar.
why: Cited as the source of Levandowski's remark agreeing with Elon Musk that lidar is a crutch.

quote.text: Anthony Levandowski of Waymo LIDAR fame has said he now agrees with Elon Musk
